answer_1.quote: Image Difference Captioning (IDC) aims to generate a natural-language description that captures the subtle differences between two similar images.
answer_1.outputs: captions describing the salient differences between image pairs

answer_2.quote: We use the standard evaluation protocol to evaluate the image difference captioning quality with metrics including BLEU-4 (B4), METEOR (M), ROUGE-L (R) and CIDEr-D (C).
